rationale: Ground truth centers on two threads: finishing the validation table (moot in this final diff) and whether Ref2VA actually works. Y directly engages the live Ref2VA risk — flags the untested Ref2VA + 2-GPU OOM exposure, a broken restart command due to partial download patterns, and the uncopyable audio_reference file format — while X only brushes it via the audio_reference doc gap. X's findings (numactl flag mislabeling, dangling RTX-PRO-5000 reference, metric-name mismatch) are accurate and well-cited but skew toward polish/nits; Y's Major section surfaces more consequential, well-evidenced issues (unidentifiable memory-model fit, self-contradicting floor claim) alongside the same numactl/RTX-5000 catches X made, giving it both broader coverage and comparable grounding.
